summary.text: Anthony Lyon is the Democratic candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 34B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
A political consultant and campaign organizer, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he has worked for candidates and causes of both parties.

paragraphs.text: Lyon's Ballotpedia profile lists Hudson High School and a bachelor's degree from Hiram College in 2021.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in a Republican family, describes himself as an independent at heart, and chose the Democratic Party as the one that represents him more.
He said he has been a campaign organizer since 2018.
Lyon named more resources for Harford County, a lower cost of living and restoring civility as his key messages.
He said he supports open primaries that allow independents to vote and reduced money in politics.
